svg.title: Team-building local sensitivity — editable wireframe preview
svg.desc: Illustrative design, not measured results. A 50-versus-50 team plot, selected roster and edit difference intervals, four benchmark panels, and interaction notes.

text.tspan: How much does one legal edit change a team?
